# laravelforge_nginx_templates (Resource)

Create a new nginx template on the server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelforge_nginx_templates" "example" {
  content      = "example-content"
  name         = "example-name"
  organization = "my-org"
  server       = 123456
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) The content of the Nginx template.
- `name` (String) The name of the Nginx template.
- `organization` (String) The organization slug
- `server` (Number) The server ID

### Optional

- `nginx_template` (Number) The nginx template ID

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravelforge_nginx_templates.example my-org/123456/123
```
